statement.name: dummy
statement.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {x : G} {n : ℕ},
  x ^ n = 1 →
    ∀ (H : Subgroup G),
      (∃ k, k ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ k} ∧ ∀ (N : Subgroup G), H ≤ N → N = ⊤ ∨ N = H) ↔
        ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ (n / p)}

comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ {G : Type u_0} [inst : Group G] {x : G} {n : ℕ},
  x ^ n = 1 →
    ∀ (H : Subgroup G),
      (∃ k, k ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ k} ∧ ∀ (N : Subgroup G), H ≤ N → N = ⊤ ∨ N = H) ↔
        ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ (n / p)}
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ {n : ℕ+} {G : Type u_0} [inst : Group G] {x : G},
  orderOf x = ↑n →
    G = ↥(Subgroup.closure {x}) →
      ∀ (H : Subgroup G),
        (∃ p, Prime p ∧ p ∣ ↑n ∧ H = Subgroup.closure {x ^ p}) ↔ H ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ (K : Subgroup G), H ≤ K → K = H ∨ K = ⊤
